title: The First Snow
offer: Snowflakes! Winter is near. Our store needs feed for the animals: six crates of hay and four of grain. Your hold takes eight: think how to row it!

steps.say: Hay for the sheep, the goats and Rosa. Now the grain.
The store is full! Let the snow come. Come in, the soup is hot.

fact: In winter, the animals stayed in the barn for months and ate the hay of the summer.
